# Singapore Property & Finance - Daily Brief (property + finance)
_Auto-generated 04 Nov 2026 (SGT). Source-linked. General information only; exact figures and eligibility are confirmed case by case._

---

## New Launch Update

- **Thomson Reserve sells 90.1% at launch, all 3- and 4-bedroom units taken up** - Thomson Reserve sold 1,143 of its 1,268 homes over its launch weekend at an average price of S$2,900 psf, making it the year's best-selling new condominium launch. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/thomson-reserve-launch-sales/)

- **Only 2-bedroom and 5-bedroom suites remain at Thomson Reserve** - After the launch weekend, 123 two-bedders and 2 five-bedroom suites are the only remaining units, priced from S$1.635M. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/thomson-reserve-sold-1143-units/)

---

## HDB Resale Market

- **First S$1.8M HDB resale flat recorded in Queenstown** - A 5-room flat at SkyParc @ Dawson sold for S$1.818 million, becoming the first HDB flat in Singapore to cross the S$1.8 million mark, setting new records on both absolute price and psf basis. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/first-s1-8m-hdb-resale-flat-in-singapore-recorded-in-queenstown/)

- **Tampines executive flat sells for record S$1.275M** - An executive flat at Tampines Palmspring changed hands for S$1.275 million, setting a new price record for executive flats in Tampines and ranking as the town's second highest HDB resale across all flat types. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/tampines-palmspring-executive-flat-record-1-275-million/)

---

## Private Market Trends & Land Supply

- **Price gap between CCR and RCR condos is the narrowest since 1998** - Prime (CCR) resale condos now cost just 1.19x city-fringe (RCR) ones per sq ft, the smallest differential between the two segments in nearly three decades. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/prime-resale-condos-cost-1-19x/)

- **Two GLS Reserve List sites at Chuan Grove and former Raffles Town Club could yield 1,180 homes** - URA has released the two residential sites under the 2H2026 Government Land Sales Reserve List, with the Chuan Grove site alone potentially yielding around 930 homes. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/gls-reserve-list-site-chuan-grove-former-raffles-town-club-1180-homes/)

---
